tool_description: Return raw historical repair experience for exactly one MES error type, optionally restricted by time and production line.
server_instruction: Use get_repair_experience when the user asks how a known error was repaired in previous incidents. error_id is required and represents exactly one error type. date_from, date_to, and line_ids are optional; omission means all available repair history or all lines for that dimension. There is no station filter. The MCP tool returns raw repair records and does not summarize them.

field_descriptions.error_id: Required single known MES error ID whose historical repair experience should be retrieved.
field_descriptions.date_from: Optional inclusive timezone-naive ISO-8601 lower bound for repaired incident occurrence time.
field_descriptions.date_to: Optional timezone-naive ISO-8601 upper bound for repaired incident occurrence time.
field_descriptions.line_ids: Optional production line filter using line IDs 1 through 4.
